_bind_note: Replace 10.0.1.42 with THIS node's management address. Never 0.0.0.0: the wildcard includes the bridge gateway 10.231.0.1 that every guest has as its default route, and guest-to-host packets hit the INPUT hook, which the agent's own forward-chain tenant isolation never sees — a tenant with root in their own sandbox would reach this root API and exec into every other tenant's guest. On a WireGuard-overlay fleet bind the node's overlay address instead (DEPLOYMENT.md 6.3).
